item.title: Show HN: HackerBooks – HackerTube, but for books mentioned on HN
item.description: Saw Karpathy's HackerTube and wanted the same thing for books. So I had Claude build one (Opus 5.5). It's ~16.5k books that at least two different HN commenters brought up, from 2007 till now. Each book links back to the comments that mentioned it. Data is downloadable from the about page. To be clear: Claude wrote almost all of it, including the data pipeline and the site. I mostly steered and made calls, bought the domain name, etc. It counts mentions, so it's not perfect (praising a book and trashing it both count). If your favourite book is missing or matched to the wrong thing, tell me… Fuente: Hacker News - Portada.

item.title: China ofrece sueldos de un millón de yuanes por el ingeniero de IA que también buscan Anthropic y OpenAI
item.description: Un millón de yuanes al año (unos 134.000 euros). Ese es el sueldo que las grandes tecnologícas chinas, entre ellas ByteDance, Tencent y Alibaba, están ofreciendo a un perfil técnico muy concreto, como explica el South China Morning Post : el forward-deployed engineer o ingeniero desplegado en cliente. O lo que es lo mismo, hablar con el cliente para entender su problema, eligen las herramientas de IA adecuadas e implementan la solución.
